scientific_integrity: Explicit analytic proof with positive inner and outer moment certificates. Finite exact-rational checks corroborate only N=6,8,10. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Even complete graphs of order at least six; intrinsic Euclidean metric on degree-one affine hull; no extension to arbitrary graphs or weighted metrics. Prior equivalent published formulations remain possible.
title: Blossom-facet screening and identical John–Löwner ellipsoids for integral and fractional one-factor polytopes
